sources.name: Automatic Recognition and Generation of Indian Sign Language (ARGISL)
sources.organization: Department of Computer Science, RKMVERI (Belur Math) & FDMSE RKMVERI (Coimbatore)
sources.dataset_name: FDMSE-ISL Research Dataset & Digital ISL Dictionary
sources.vocabulary_scope: 2,002 commonly used ISL glosses / daily words
sources.description: Joint academic initiative by RKMVERI Belur and Coimbatore campuses. Features 2,002 digital ISL dictionary entries and the multi-angle 40,033-video FDMSE-ISL isolated gesture dataset.
sources.licensing_terms: Dictionary entries indexed for accessibility and learning with attribution. Raw research dataset available upon academic request.
sources.demonstrations_format: Video clips and embedded web players
sources.research_access_instructions: To request access to the raw FDMSE-ISL dataset recordings, researchers should submit a formal application to the RKMVERI Computer Science Department at Belur Math via cs.rkmvu.ac.in/~isl/.

sources.name: Indian Sign Language Portal
sources.organization: Faculty of Disability Management and Special Education (FDMSE), RKMVERI (Coimbatore Campus)
sources.dataset_name: Online ISL Dictionary & Categorized Learning Portal
sources.vocabulary_scope: Comprehensive A-Z dictionary and thematic categories
sources.description: Official online portal maintained by FDMSE RKMVERI Coimbatore offering A to Z browsing, video demonstrations, English glosses, and verified Tamil translations.
sources.licensing_terms: Educational non-commercial indexing with direct citation and embedded video links.
sources.demonstrations_format: Embedded video players / YouTube official channels
sources.research_access_instructions: Educational materials are accessible online; institutional permissions managed by FDMSE RKMVERI Coimbatore.

fdmse_isl_dataset_note: The raw multi-angle FDMSE-ISL dataset (40,033 videos across 2,002 signs recorded at 60fps) is a restricted academic research dataset maintained by RKMVERI Belur & Coimbatore. SignHome indexes dictionary glosses, Tamil meanings, and web demonstration links with full attribution. Model training uses independent recorded landmark samples.
